title: Binary Search (Recursive)
prompt:
Implement a recursive binary search in `solution.ts`.

**Approach:**
Define an inner helper function that takes `left` and `right` bounds. Base case: if `left > right`, return `-1`. Otherwise compute `mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2)`. If the middle element equals the target, return `mid`. If it is less than the target, recurse on the right half. Otherwise recurse on the left half.

**Requirements:**
1. Export `search(nums: number[], target: number): number` -- takes a sorted array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, returns the index of `target` in `nums` or `-1` if not found
2. Use a recursive helper function (no while loop)
3. The outer function calls the helper with initial bounds `0` and `nums.length - 1`

**Examples:**
```typescript
search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 9)   // 4
search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 2)   // -1
search([5], 5)                      // 0
search([], 3)                       // -1
```

**Complexity:** O(log n) time, O(log n) space (call stack).
hints: Define a nested helper(left, right) function inside search
Base case: if left > right, the target is not in the array
Recurse on helper(mid + 1, right) when nums[mid] < target
Remember to return the result of each recursive call

solution.ts.name: search
solution.ts.description: Export search as a named export
